messages:
deploybot: ALERT: Canary group 'prod-canary' v3.4.1 triggered rollback threshold -> p95 latency x2.9, error rate 7.1% (> configured). Recommending automated rollback to v3.4.0 in 4m unless overridden. logs: https://dash.redwood/prod-canary/184001
Maya Singh: holding auto for 5. We have two dedicated EU pools pinned to v3.4.1 and one large customer with active sessions. Need a plan to avoid churn for dedicated.
Liam Ford: Agreed. Suggest scoped rollback: hosted API + new session traffic -> v3.4.0; keep existing dedicated sessions on v3.4.1. That minimizes impact.
Priya Rao: ok. Who will run rollback for hosted slice? Also open RW-11234 for follow-up RCA.
Maya Singh: Liam can run it, Priya will coordinate customer-succ comms. Add a 20m validation window after rollback before wider actions.
Liam Ford: command I'll run (please verify):
```
deployctl rollout --env=prod --service=hosted-api --from-version=v3.4.1 --to-version=v3.4.0 --traffic-selector=new_sessions --confirm
```
ops-bot: ACTION CREATED RW-11234 (rollback exec + rca) owner=Liam Ford.
Liam Ford: executing now. deploybot: starting partial rollback job id=rb-184001. ETA ~90s.
deploybot: rb-184001 progress: route-update applied -> new_sessions routed to v3.4.0.
Liam Ford: smoke: 60/60 OK. p95 dropping, errors down to 1.2%. Holding 20m.
Priya Rao: ping @cs-team: Heads-up email draft in #customer-success-drafts: short note that active sessions won't be interrupted; new sessions will hit fallback version while we investigate.
Maya Singh: good. Also add a temporary guard to reject requests that hit the failing memory path if possible. Opened RW-11235 to track guard work.
ops-bot: ROLLBACK COMPLETED rb-184001 by Liam Ford. Monitoring window 20m.
deploybot: Telemetry update @ 10m: p95 stable, errors ~1.0%. No change in throughput.
Priya Rao: I'll update the release-notes: "2026-03-21: Partial rollback of hosted-new-session traffic v3.4.1 -> v3.4.0 due to KV-cache related OOM retries; Dedicated pools remain pinned to v3.4.1."
Maya Singh: thanks team. After hold we'll do a 30m post-check and then a quick sync to assign RCA owners. RW-11234 + RW-11235 linked.
